about.title: About us
about.question: Why choose our cleaning services?
about.body: Cleaning is the only thing we do, and we do it properly. The team is trained for the work, turns up when it said it would, and pays attention to the details that get skipped when a job is rushed. That attention is what earns a client's trust, and it is what we are judged on every visit.

points.1: We hire carefully and train before anyone works in a client's home, so the standard does not depend on who is on the job that day.
points.2: We take the cleaning off your hands, which is hours a week back for whatever you would rather be doing.
points.3: Homes and offices alike get the same standard of work, planned around the space rather than a fixed checklist.
